verdict.rationale: LightSprint is a SaaS platform for coding agents and task workflows, so outbound webhook subscriptions are a fair axis. Nothing in the evidence documents webhooks or event subscriptions. The two-way Slack/Linear/Jira sync and MCP integrations are prebuilt connectors, not user-configurable event webhooks. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404, so there is no public API surface to check.
